svg.title: Displacement, velocity and acceleration in simple harmonic motion

cc:Work.dc:title: Displacement, velocity and acceleration in simple harmonic motion
cc:Work.dc:description: Released from positive amplitude at time zero. Displacement is cosine, velocity negative sine, and acceleration negative cosine. The ordinate of each panel is separately normalised.
